question.prompt: \(A(0,0,0)\), \(B(0,3,0)\). What is the \(y\)-coordinate of the vector corresponding to the directed line segment \(AB\)?

solutions.explanation: Subtract the starting point's \(y\)-coordinate from the endpoint's \(y\)-coordinate: \(3-0=3\).
solutions.title: Subtract starting coordinate from endpoint coordinate
